title: Estimator
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: PROJECT ENGINEER / ESTIMATOR
Project Engineer/Estimator will provide technical support to the Estimating Team and Project Management Team. The position will bridge the process of project estimation through project completion. The following list is a summary of responsibilities although additional work tasks may be required by the company’s operations or clients.

  • Project Engineer will report to the Executive Vice President of Preconstruction
  • Attend pre-bid meetings with customers, owners, engineers, and architects as required.
  • Meet weekly to review bid priorities. Ensure that all bids are prepared and submitted as directed by the Exec VP of Pre-Construction.
  • Perform accurate estimate take-offs to provide project quantities to the Estimating Team using Blue Beam
  • Attend formal and informal training sessions to understand the various Software Programs utilized in Estimating (Blue Beam, Heavy Bid) and Project Management (Sage, Microsoft Project)
  • As required, pick up plans for jobs to be estimated from customer locations. Review specifics of the job with the customer while at the project site
  • Obtain quotes from at least three sources of supply for equipment rentals and materials to be purchased.
  • As necessary, visit job sites of projects being bid to ensure that all job conditions are known and accounted for in the estimate.
  • Where appropriate, maintain and revise a checklist of general jobsite conditions that could potentially affect the company’s costs to perform a project.
  • When jobs are awarded to the company, prepare purchase orders with vendors for materials with releases to be scheduled by the project team.
  • After orders have been placed with vendors, make follow-up calls as appropriate to ensure the timely delivery/availability of the materials as per the schedule.
  • When bidding projects or phases significantly different from past jobs, obtain input from the Project Manager to ensure agreement that all requirements have been adequately identified and that sufficient hours have been estimated.
  • When bidding a job for a contractor, determine, where possible what other contractors are bidding the work and advise the estimating team.
  • Create estimate proposal letters for client submission
  • As jobs are awarded to the company, attend job kick-off meetings and provide information to the Project Manager and Job Foremen on the details of each project.
  • When jobs are awarded to the company, create an electronic “CONFORMED ESTIMATE” file that includes all quotes, drawings, subcontracts and all final documents upon which the project price was based.
  • Perform and update all NJ One Calls for the company.
  • As required by the scope of the additional work being requested by the customer, prepare estimates for change orders and submit them for approval.
  • On a regular basis search for new sources of supply for the company’s most commonly purchased items. Where possible, maintain at least two vendors for all commonly purchased items.
  • Advise subcontractors whose performance requires removal from the approved list. Propose potential new subcontractors.
  • Handle all warranty returns to the manufacturers of any defective equipment returned from the field.
  • Complete and maintain the HC Project Checklist for each new Job Award and ensure that all tasks are completed by the due dates as established by the Job Kick-off meeting.
  • Job Award
    • Primary Role:
      • Attend all Job Award Meetings
    • Support Project Manager with:
      • Review of Job Plans and Specs thoroughly within 2 days of Job Award- notify Project Manager of any discrepancies or inconsistencies
      • Determine HC Schedule Based on HC Estimate and Customer Requirements
  • Job Set Up
    • Obtain all current plans and specifications from Estimating folder and move to Construction file
    • Print set for Project Manager and Foreman
    • Work with Estimating to get all reports from HCSS to Construction file
      • Cost Report
      • Resource Report
  • Plans and Specification
    • Familiarize with plans, specifications, and Scope of work Letter
  • Subcontractor and material Procurement
    • Review project plans and Resource Report for all subcontractor and vendor requirements for the project
    • Subcontractors:
      • Obtain three quotes for subcontract work. Work with Estimating to see if three quotes was already secured.
      • Prepare leveling sheet for final selection of subcontractors
  • Work with Project Manager and Purchasing to complete subcontracting process with subcontract agreement. Subcontract agreement issuance to be by Purchasing
  • Vendors
    • Perform take off verification of material quantities from plans and estimate
    • Obtain three quotes for major vendor materials. Work with Estimating to see if three quotes was already secured.
    • Prepare leveling sheet for final selection of vendors.
    • Work with Project Manager and Purchasing to complete buy out process. Purchase order issuance to be by Purchasing
  • Submittals
    • Develop submittal checklist from plans and specifications
    • Assist in obtaining and reviewing information and approvals for processing of shop drawings, product data and samples. Assist in the communication of this information across all levels of the project team.
    • Work with Project Manager and Dee to have them submitted to client
  • Scheduling
    • Work with Project Managers to get schedules into Microsoft Projects and to help facilitate Two Week Look Aheads
  • Request for Information
    • Assist Project Managers in the submission and responses for Requests for Information (RFI’s).
  • Change Orders
    • Assisting Project Manager and Estimators with take offs and pricing for change order of ongoing projects.
  • As-Builts
    • Assist in the preparation of final records for the project including close-out documents, Operations/Maintenance (OM) Manuals, etc.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Job Description:

Role Overview:
  • Supports key strategic initiatives in the planning, analysis, and delivery of projects
  • Drives project execution for respective areas and owns key initiatives within their function

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and manage project lifecycles for strategic initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with Technology Relations objectives (30%)
  • Identify and implement new tactics to support overarching Technology Relations goals across multiple functions, leveraging cross-functional collaboration (20%)
  • Develop and deploy strategic key messages for Global Technology, ensuring clarity and consistency across communications (20%)
  • Own the creation and maintenance of functional calendars and knowledge repositories to enhance team coordination and information sharing (15%)
  • Develop, uplift, and maintain playbooks documenting key areas of expertise for internal training and external knowledge sharing (15%)

Project Management Capabilities:
  • Plan, organize, and manage projects from initiation through closure, applying best practices in scope, schedule, and resource management
  • Utilize project management tools and methodologies to track progress, manage risks, and communicate status to stakeholders effectively
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, facilitating collaboration and resolving issues to keep projects on track
  • Prioritize tasks and manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating agility and problem-solving skills
  • Prepare project documentation, including charters, plans, status reports, and post-project reviews to support continuous improvement
  • Engage with senior leadership and C-Suite stakeholders, understanding their needs and delivering accurate, timely updates and deliverables

Skills and Attributes:
  • Ability to create vision and strategy and equally important, drive execution—both thinker and doer
  • Proactive and self-motivated, working ahead of deadlines and exceeding expectations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and deep organizational capabilities
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team
  • Comfortable operating under tight deadlines in a dynamic environment
  • Understanding of C-Suite priorities, emphasizing accuracy and expediency

Impact:
  • Contributes to the achievement of team objectives and supports the functional area’s success through effective project management and strategic execution

Required Skills/Experience:
  • PowerPoint, Word, and SharePoint experience
  • Project Management experience
  • Ability to create vision and strategy and equally important, drive execution—both thinker and doer
  • Proactive and self-motivated, working ahead of deadlines and exceeding expectations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and deep organizational capabilities
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team
  • Comfortable operating under tight deadlines in a dynamic environment
  • Understanding of C-Suite priorities, emphasizing accuracy and expediency

Preferred Skills/Experience:
  • Technical and/or engineering background

Required Software/Technology:
  • SharePoint
  • Microsoft Office Suite

Preferred Education/Certification(s):
  • Bachelor’s degree

Additional Information:
  • Duration: 13 Weeks, 3 Days
  • Hybrid Work Model: 4 days onsite required weekly in Downtown Pittsburgh
  • Rate Range: $40-45/hr. W2 (based on experience)

title: Senior Network Project Manager - Real Estate
description:
Job Description:
  • The Workplace Solutions Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible to plan, coordinate and execute the highest priority projects across Digital Workplace and Enterprise Services working groups.
  • As a Project Manager within the PMO, you are disciplined and skilled at keeping cross-functional teams on track communicating clear goals developed with the PMO leadership team, achievable project plans and clear reporting. Projects will range from large, cross-functional initiatives, often combined with real estate projects or integration efforts associated with mergers and acquisitions works to smaller projects
  • You are also skilled at organizing people and activities and simplifying complex processes into obtainable goals. You are comfortable wearing multiple hats and will readily go from project manager to project / technology coordinator as needed. You are familiar with and comfortable managing all aspects of project delivery from the installation of technology infrastructure through end user computing solutions.
  • Managing risk and overcoming obstacles in real-time is your forte. A project isn’t finished for you until its properly closed out and a full lessons learned conducted and actioned against.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Delivering Projects:
    • Responsible for managing project delivery within the agreed upon schedule, budget and scope.
    • You will work with ES functions to establish project-related goals, budget and onboard following the D&IO protocols
    • You will track and report on project delivery, workflow, budget performance and risk management for the project team and senior leadership
    • You will participate in project improvement meetings, facilitating and driving process improvement in the PMO and beyond
    • You will build your technology network across infrastructure, engineering, digital workplace and other teams to keep our projects on track
  • Supporting the Culture: Fostering a disciplined Program/Project Management framework within Enterprise Services with a focus on clear communication, planning and execution of technical and operational work, including:
    • Partnering with the PMO team to build the ES PMO playbook with tools and processes that promote efficiency and transparency, especially in our global environment
    • Delivering consistent project management practices across Enterprise Services regardless if they are led by our PMO or the function
    • Keeping the employee experience is at the center of what we do and partnering effectively to support a robust approach to change management
    • Attention to detail with emphasis on smooth transition from PMO to BAU
  • Building the Team: You enjoy being part of a growing team and want all members to be setup for success. You will play an integral role in the building out of our team, learning from each other and building out the best PMO program for our team.

Skills/Qualifications:
  • 5 years of relevant experience running projects ideally with a workplace strategy or workplace operations and technology background (design/build, software/tools implementation, networking, IT infrastructure, hardware and application deployment
  • Experience managing complex/cross-functional projects
  • Good interpersonal skills with the ability to build diverse relationships and influence technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven ability to think strategically and focus on business growth

Additional Information:
  • Duration: 6-12 month contract to hire
  • Hybrid Work Model: 3 days onsite required weekly in Midtown Manhattan with potential travel to Princeton, NJ

title: Strategic Sourcing Senior Specialist
description:
The candidate will need to have knowledge/experience with MSPs.
The Expense Management and Strategic Sourcing team is responsible for effectively managing client's external spend, while continuously seeking areas of opportunity to create cost efficiencies throughout the firm. In addition, this team’s mission is to offer comprehensive spend transparency through innovative analytics. The team utilizes this data to optimize expenses through the application of traditional and non-traditional cost reduction strategies.

Role and responsibilities
Your role will primarily be responsible for supporting special projects and expense management activities across all categories of spend within the firm, including, but not limited to, Technology, Market Data, Marketing, Finance, and Legal. Ideal candidates are required to possess a strong background in analytics, consultative engagements, expense management, and communications (PowerPoint). This role will also benefit from experience in sourcing, project and change management. This role will include exposure to senior management.

Responsibilities:
• Identifies, establishes and maintains relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers and influencers internally and externally
• Analyzes external & internal spend data to identify savings opportunities and strategies
• Provides subject matter expertise to internal stakeholders, team members, colleagues, etc. on projects
• Participates in both internal and external projects that are broad in scope and closely tied to the organizational strategy
• Contributes to the improvement and development of strategic, operational, and tactical processes to achieve the most cost effective and efficient sourcing practices
• Coordinates discussions and reviews with various internal and external stakeholders
• Leads/assists competitive bid evaluations and provides recommendations based on thorough analysis
• Creates executive summary presentations for senior management review
You will need the following skills and experience
• Education Required: Degree qualified in relevant discipline or equivalent working experience
• Experience Required: 3 to 5 years of experience in relevant discipline
• Strong analytical, problem solving, and decision making skills
• Strong skills in both verbal and written communication
• Skills in problem identification, analysis, and resolution
• Must be adaptable and flexible
• Must be a team player
• Ability to perform multiple tasks in a complex operating environment

Strategic Tasks: 60-70%
o Lead Contract Negotiations
o Stakeholder Influence & management
o Senior leader visibility
o Opportunity Identification
o Spend Analysis

• Operational Tasks: 30-40%
o Coupa Requisition Review & Approval Process
o Contract Tagging
o Supplier Onboarding
o Various other operational & system duties

The below would be preferred, but not required:
• Consulting experience
• Experience with Power BI, or other analytical tools a plus

title: Corporate Insurance Specialist
description:
Corporate Insurance Specialist

  • The ideal candidate will serve as a Property & Casualty insurance subject matter expert and will play a pivotal role in the development, renewal, and management of insurance programs for both corporate entities and subsidiaries. This role is responsible for evaluating coverage options, negotiating policy terms and conditions, and educating stakeholders on insurance policies.
  • Prepare underwriting submission materials and facilitate placement and maintenance of corporate insurance programs, including but not limited to Property & Casualty programs (international and domestic), Workers Compensation, Construction Insurance (OCIP, Builders Risk, Owners Interest Liability, etc.).
  • Support multiple business lines with subsidiary insurance renewals, including but not limited to Master Trust, Fidelity Bonds, Miscellaneous Error & Omission and Director & Officers liability placements worldwide.
  • Respond to internal and external inquiries in relation to insurance requirements. Review vendor and supplier contracts, real estate lease agreements, and Requests for Proposals (RFPs) to ensure compliance with insurance requirements.
  • Perform administrative tasks such as maintaining and updating insurance schedules, administering claims for all corporate and subsidiary policies, verifying insurance binders and policies for accuracy, coordinating with Accounts Payable and Finance to ensure timely premium payments, and handling other internal governance tasks.
  • Independently manage multiple ad hoc projects and ensure timely and successful completion. Demonstrate strong organizational, verbal, and written communication skills. Act as a proactive self-starter dedicated to continuous learning and effective collaboration.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in the Property & Casualty insurance industry required. Prior Real Estate / Construction Insurance experience preferred.

title: Quality Technician - Non Exempt
description:
Quality Technician Overview

The Quality Technician is capable of conducting, auditing, inspecting, and testing of the Quality System Programs. Each technician must appropriately monitor and respond to all process operating guidelines.

QC Technician Daily Responsibilities

1. Key point of contact to help identify and resolve issues for any and all food safety, regulatory and quality issues on the shift (holds, sanitation concerns, start ups, extraneous investigations, etc)

2. Product attributes for the previous shift must be reviewed at the beginning of each shift (including net contents). Operations will print all holdable attributes from KPOG for the shift folder which is turned into QA at the end of their shift.


3. Each technician is to review mixing sheets (207’s) during the shift. When auditing the mixing sheets, errors such as incorrect lot numbers, quantities, temperatures, etc should be identified.


4. Metal Detection
a. Review Metal Detector checks completed during the shift and react to any non-conformities, sign off at the end of the shift.
b. If any metal detector failure/deviation occurs a risk assessment must be completed by the end of your shift on the day of the occurrence.
c. Create and maintain test packages.

5. Holds
a. Technician will lead the initial investigation and get the right resources involved in the investigation to complete the 5 why and corrective action sections.
b. Holds must be documented in the database and must clearly identify the non-conformities. Supporting data should be documented in the hold details. Supporting data includes, but is not limited to, the following: Investigation details, root cause/corrective action, KPOGs data points, specification limits .
c. Categorize (I, II, or III) holds appropriately
d. Take pictures of any issues that will support the hold for non-conforming product.
e. Perform traces in Red Prairie and notify Supervisor/manager if suspect product has shipped.
f. Request product from the hi-rise, assess pallet timeframes to see which pallets fit the hold timeline for disposition or rework.
g. Set up rework form and pull samples for retesting. Work with operations to sample/rework Quality Holds.
h. Reconcile hold folder up to and including holds database, kwic report and hold form.
i.

6. Model 26 Documentation is to be reviewed daily. Any deviations should be captured in the Deviation report & Finished Goods hold notice to Quality management and operations (BUMS, Supervisor, etc).

7. Extraneous findings should be uploaded to the team-site and stored in the file cabinet in the Main Quality office. They are not to be left on the counter.

i. Lead the extraneous investigations to determine the source. Assist operations in completing the Deviation Reports.

8. GMP/Food Safety Inspections
i. Pre-operational inspections must be completed prior to start-up whenever an area has been idle for 8 hours or more. Production lines should not start up unless the required paperwork ins turned into Quality and completed forms are stored in the appropriate binder located in the Quality office
ii. Equipment must be inspected after maintenance work is completed. An orange tag will need to be signed off for these events.
iii. Ad hoc inspections are required for other events that are Quality or Food Safety concerns: environmental issues, bloodborne pathogens, brittle plastic or broken glass


9. Each QC technician is expected to troubleshoot and resolve issues for equipment occurring on their shift.

10. Shift Reports must be completed and saved to the team site on a daily basis to keep track of all quality issues that occur on each shift.

QC Technician Individual Responsibilities

• Lab equipment (weekly) calibrations
• RFT/Faulty –
• GMP Inspections
• Incoming ingredient review & release
• Raw and packaging material complaints/investigations
• Consumer complaint investigations
• Provide Quality training sessions at Leadership meetings and assist with all required Compliance trainings for hourly employees.

Additional Information
Shift is 3pm - 11pm
Onsite
$28.00 - $30.00 based on experience
